title: GROUP PREFERENCE OPTIMIZATION: FEW-SHOT ALIGNMENT OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
benchmark_measurement: Alignment of Large Language Model responses with the opinion distributions of various religious demographic groups on survey questions concerning social and political issues.
findings: The proposed Group Preference Optimization (GPO) method effectively aligns LLM outputs with the specific opinion distributions of various religious groups (including Protestant, Jewish, Hindu, Atheist, and Muslim) using only a few examples. Qualitative examples show GPO adapting to the views of these groups on topics like same-sex marriage, economic inequality, and immigration, outperforming standard steered models which often exhibit strong biases toward a specific answer.
